toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":6,"perceivedCorrectness":85,"actionability":7,"reason":"The brief backs its diagnosis with several independent lines of evidence (the leak rig was out of service, certificate sequences were reused, the teardown found deformed seals, helium retests showed 11% vs 1%, and installer and firmware splits were flat), and it gives clear, staged actions for the held lots and the line-stoppage risk, though I can't verify the new evidence myself."}

output.reason: The brief backs its diagnosis with several independent lines of evidence (the leak rig was out of service, certificate sequences were reused, the teardown found deformed seals, helium retests showed 11% vs 1%, and installer and firmware splits were flat), and it gives clear, staged actions for the held lots and the line-stoppage risk, though I can't verify the new evidence myself.
